integrity: All-size statements are proved by the four-symbol column identity and counting arguments. Python finite enumeration is corroboration, not an infinite certificate. No independent scientific review has occurred.
scientific_limitations: The exact conclusions concern noiseless NEC majority on the 2-by-n periodic strip only, n>=2. The logarithmic-time statement uses uniform iid input; no conclusion is made for taller, noisy, or boundary-driven systems. Two plausible historical sources were accessible only at abstract level, leaving residual originality risk.
title: Exact attractor and basin law for the two-row Toom cellular automaton
